svg.title: AREA 29
svg.desc: At the four-pad puzzle, press only front-left from the entrance. The light switch unlocks only after the dark room is clear; use the minimap to fight before then. After the boss-hall wave, send one player back to the timed switch while the others collect boxes. The switch also raises a trap; clear it for the returning player.
